description: Norway's national register of mineral occurrences. The Geonorge metadata page says the dataset gives an overview of recorded industrial mineral, natural stone and metal resources as area and point entries, covering documented deposits with a value assessment, prospective areas, occurrences where raised values were observed or analysed, and provinces, and that documented deposits carry a rating of public importance from international to none. It says the data come from NGU's mineral deposit database, are updated continuously from field work and reports, and are used to protect current and future extraction areas in municipal and county land-use plans. Formats are FGDB, Shape and SOSI, with a Geonorge download, an Atom feed and WMS services for industrial minerals, metals and natural stone. The licence is the Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD) and access is open. The resource was updated on 30 March 2026. Coverage is Norway. Caveats: the same physical deposit may be recorded under different names and coordinates depending on the perspective. For simulation it locates mines and deposits as raw-material supply nodes. Related catalogue records are USGS MRDS and the BGS mineral resources maps.
